title: Uploaded Image Deletion and Recovery Policy
purpose: Proposed handoff assembled from source-linked outcomes; human source review and approval required.

scope.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.

requirements.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.

stories.text: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-immediate-permanent-delete in unresolved decision DEC-deletion-recovery: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
acceptance_criteria: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-immediate-permanent-delete in unresolved decision DEC-deletion-recovery: After the owner selects Delete for an uploaded image, the uploaded image is immediately permanently deleted and is not recoverable by the owner.

stories.text: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-30-day-owner-recovery in unresolved decision DEC-deletion-recovery: Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.
acceptance_criteria: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-30-day-owner-recovery in unresolved decision DEC-deletion-recovery: After the owner selects Delete for an uploaded image, the same deleted image remains recoverable by its owner for 30 days.

open_questions: What exact event starts the 30-day recovery period: the owner's selection of Delete, a separate confirmation, or completion of the deletion processing?
Are the 30 days counted as calendar days from a specific time zone, or as 30 elapsed 24-hour periods?
Is recovery available through the entire 30th day, or does it end at the exact 30-day boundary?
What happens after the 30-day recovery period ends; does the same image become unrecoverable, and if so, at what point and through what observable change?
How is the owner's Delete selection supplied to the system, and how is the target uploaded image identified?
How is the result of Delete reported to the owner, and how is the availability or exhaustion of recovery reported during the 30-day recovery period?
Which owner-facing UI behaviors apply under each selected alternative: immediate permanent deletion with no recovery, or deletion followed by 30-day owner recovery?
Which deletion policy should apply when an owner selects Delete for an uploaded image: immediate permanent deletion or 30-day owner recovery?
The support source states no stakeholder has authority to choose between these requests yet; who will be authorized to select between immediate permanent deletion and 30-day owner recovery?
Who is the owner accountable for this handoff plan?
What is the delivery date for this handoff plan?
